verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents a server-side support page and a NullEngine class, which give the engine a headless mode for running scenes without a browser or GPU, i.e. in Node or CI. Docs also mention offscreen rendering. However, the evidence items are bare doc URLs and titles with no described content, and nothing shows a CI or automation workflow. Missing for 10: substantive content from the server-side/NullEngine docs, CI-specific guidance (e.g. headless rendering or screenshot testing in pipelines), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
